Maren was sweeping the gallery walkway when she spotted it—a brown bottle wedged between two boulders below. She climbed down carefully, pried it free, and worked the cork loose with her knife. She folded the paper, tucked it into her coat pocket, and finished sweeping.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有完全睡着。路灯将橙黄的光晕投在空荡荡的沥青路面上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，尾灯像流星一样消失在路口。便利店的霓虹灯彻夜亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹，收音机里有人低声说话。清洁工推着小车从胡同里转出来，扫帚划过地面发出沙沙的声响，惊动了屋檐下的麻雀。远处的高楼顶端有红灯慢慢闪烁，像城市不安稳的心跳。空气是凉的，带着昨夜残存的烟火气，混杂着早点摊刚刚升起的豆浆香。这座城市在四点钟属于少数人，也属于它自己。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem, like asking \"what is 5!\" by first figuring out \"what is 4!\".\n• Every recursive function needs a stopping point called the base case, so it doesn't keep calling itself forever — like knowing that 1! is just 1 without needing to go further.\n• Think of it like a set of Russian nesting dolls: each doll opens to reveal a smaller one, until you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open — that's your base case."}
